integrity: Formal coefficient proof plus independently coded exhaustive enumeration of noncrossing partitions up to n=9; computational examples do not certify infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Uniform noncrossing partitions only; finite-sample exact covariance, not a full joint law. General rooted-tree generating functions may implicitly imply the identity; specialist priority check remains. Exact computations exhaust n<=9 only.
title: Outer-block and block-size covariance in uniform noncrossing partitions
